display_name: Consumer price index readings (CBS, January 2000 to August 2026) and the rise of the index that Income Tax Ordinance s 1 / s 120B and National Insurance Law s 334(a)(1) take from them

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Hebrew from the Laws is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated mechanically from line N of the deposited source, and in short runs checked to occur verbatim in it (tools/hebcheck.py).

source.authority: aid: unofficial Hebrew Wikisource consolidation, as amended at retrieval

other_sources.what: Income Tax Ordinance [New Version], s 1 (מדד, שיעור עליית המדד, שנת מס) and s 120B
CBS general consumer price index, code 120010, January 2000 to August 2026, 320 rows
other_sources.authority: official statistical series; published data, not law

other_sources.what: the same with the Bureau's linkage coefficients to earlier bases
other_sources.authority: official statistical series; published data, not law

generated.check: python3 tools/gen_published_figures.py --check (regenerates in memory, diffs, verifies the JSON sha256 against SOURCES.json and the coefficients against every cumulative value of the linkage file)

scope: Encoded: the CBS readings as published data (not law); ITO s 1 'מדד' and 'שיעור עליית המדד' (the index published last before the start / end of a month; the rise over a period; the rise between two readings); ITO s 120B(a) (the rise in the previous tax year), s 120B(b) (the rise from the start of the tax year to the end of a month), s 120B(e)(2) (the period of the rise on 1 January 2028, fork F2); NII s 334(a)(1) (the rise for 1 January of 2026 to 2028); the pair of readings on one scale in the shape rows IL-03 and IL-04 take as input. Out of scope: what a rise does to an amount; rounding (ITO s 120B(d), the Order is not deposited); NII s 334(a)(2) (the average wage); a special assessment period. Readings outside January 2000 to August 2026 are refused by name.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source, and no independent test pass has been run. Every expected value in cpi-il35-tests.l4 was worked by hand from the Bureau's JSON before it was asserted and is cross-checked against the JSON by tools/spotcheck_tests.py.

check.l4: ~/.local/bin/l4 -> the cabal store, /Volumes/transcend/caches/cabal/store/ghc-9.10.3-fe9c/jl4-0.1-6df1397b/bin/l4, sha256 f0759b2ef2f1d1b2a577c68f059c54f487de9d913553fc9f0d9bf0f7f5dab0d8, the same before and after the run

forks.F1: How readings of two bases are compared (the s 1 arithmetic across a change of base). RULED by Meng on 2026-10-08 (SHRUG): one named switch (`section 1 — the reading this row takes where readings are of two bases`), readings `readings of two bases are compared by linking them through the Bureau's coefficients`, `a rise over twelve months is the percent the Bureau published for the twelve months`, `a rise across a change of base is declined`; default the third, answering only where the first two give the same rise.
forks.F2: ITO s 120B(e)(2): which rise 'the index of tax year 2027' means. RULED by Meng on 2026-10-08 (SHRUG): one named switch (`section 120B(e)(2) — the reading this row takes of the rise on 1 January 2028`), readings `the rise of the index in tax year 2027 alone`, `the rise of the index from the start of tax year 2024 to the end of tax year 2027`, `the period of the rise on 1 January 2028 is declined`; default the third.
